title: Make-vs-Buy + Full Quote-to-Ship Lifecycle Pipeline
brief: MakeVsBuyDecisionEngine, ShopNetworkEngine, WorkholdingSurfaceInference, QuoteToShipOrchestrator, PackingSlip, MaterialCertTraceability, FAI Pipeline, ProductionBatchOptimization.

units.title: MakeVsBuyDecisionEngine
units.description: Per-operation: in-house cost vs vendor cost. Breakeven quantity. Lead time, quality risk, IP sensitivity.

units.title: ShopNetworkEngine
units.description: Register capabilities, broadcast overflow, receive bids. API schema for future marketplace.

units.title: WorkholdingSurfaceInferenceEngine
units.description: From STEP/B-Rep: identify grip/datum surfaces. Track survival through machining. Auto-flag when machining removes needed surface.

units.title: PackingSlipEngine
units.description: Part number, quantity, revision, material cert, inspection results, PO reference.

units.title: MaterialCertTraceabilityEngine
units.description: Heat lot → stock → program → FAI → production → shipping. AS9100/ITAR compliant.

units.title: ProductionBatchOptimizationEngine
units.description: Batch tool life, fixture loading, bar stock cutoff, probing intervals.

closure_notes: 49/49 tests pass across 10 units. Verified: MakeVsBuyDecisionEngine (analyzeJob, breakevenAnalysis), ShopNetworkEngine (registerShop/searchShops/getNetworkStats/broadcastJob), WorkholdingSurfaceInferenceEngine (inferSurfaces/trackSurvival/detectDeadEndsDirect), QuoteToShipOrchestratorEngine (getStageDescriptors/validateInput + qts_* actions), PackingSlipEngine (generate/addLineItem/finalize), MaterialCertTraceabilityEngine (registerCert with validation + traceBackward), FirstArticleInspectionPipelineEngine (runFAI + generateForms AS9102), ProductionBatchOptimizationEngine (optimizeBatch/predictToolChanges/probingSchedule). Dispatcher wiring: 22 actions across camDispatcher (10), machineSetupDispatcher (3), qualityDispatcher (4), businessDispatcher (5) — exceeds U09 threshold of 9. Test count 49 exceeds U10 threshold of 40.
